title: Residential Electricity Supply Rebill Credits: Tenure Courtesy
content:
**Rule.** On a Residential Electricity Supply off-peak rebill, when the agreement's service start date is 12 or more whole months before the correction date the long rebill tenure courtesy of 2.00 USD is added, when it is 6 to 11 whole months before the mid rebill tenure courtesy of 1.00 USD is added, and when it is fewer than 6 whole months before nothing is added.

**Counting.** From the service start date recorded on the agreement to the correction date, in whole months; a month is whole once the same day of the month is reached.

| Service start (hypothetical) | Correction date | Whole months | Rebill tenure courtesy |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2025-01-31 | 2026-01-31 | 12 | 2.00 USD |
| 2025-01-31 | 2026-01-30 | 11 | 1.00 USD |
| 2025-07-10 | 2026-01-10 | 6 | 1.00 USD |
| 2025-07-10 | 2026-01-09 | 5 | nothing |
